# Working Directory Behavior Test

This runbook tests that the working directory behaves correctly across different
block types and scenarios.

## Scenario 1: A cd stays inside its script

A Command block that changes directory doesn't move the blocks after it.

<Command
    id="cd-subdir"
    command="mkdir -p subdir && cd subdir && pwd"
    title="Change directory to subdir"
    description="Creates ./subdir and cd's into it"
/>

<Command
    id="verify-cwd"
    command='pwd; echo "cwd=$(pwd)" >> "${RUNBOOK_OUTPUT:-/dev/null}"'
    title="Verify CWD"
    description="Should show the session's directory, not subdir"
/>

## Scenario 2: workingDir picks where a block runs

<Command
    id="verify-cwd-in-subdir"
    workingDir="subdir"
    command='pwd; echo "cwd=$(pwd)" >> "${RUNBOOK_OUTPUT:-/dev/null}"'
    title="Verify CWD with workingDir"
    description="Should show that we're inside subdir"
/>

## Scenario 3: GitClone resolves relative to the session's directory

The `cd` above doesn't change where a GitClone block clones to.

<GitClone
    id="clone-after-cd"
    title="Clone after cd"
    description="Enter a git URL to clone"
/>
